newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE -- Florida Housing Finance Agency.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE -- Florida Housing Finance Agency.

text.p: Separate sealed bids for the Series G and Series H Bonds will be received in the office of the Division of Bond Finance at the address given below up to such dates and times as will be communicated through MUNIFACTS NEWS SERVICE and THOMSON MUNICIPAL MARKET MONITOR not less than 20 hours prior to the time bids are to be opened. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Notice of Bond Sale and the Bid forms may be obtained, when available, from the Director, Division of Bond Finance, 1801 Hermitage Boulevard, Suite 200, Tallahassee, Florida 32308, telephone (904) 488-4782.
*Preliminary, subject to change as provided in the Notice of Bond Sale.
